desc: Parse N, R, C, and S; map N/W/S/E to coordinate deltas and initialize the current prefix position to (0,0) with a visited set containing (0,0).
Iterate through S, updating the current prefix position for each character and inserting it into the visited set.
For each time t, compute the required relative coordinate P_t - (R,C) and append '1' if it is in the visited set, otherwise '0'.
Use an efficient coordinate representation such as a tuple or encoded integer for hashing, then join and print the resulting N-character answer.
